description: Prepare a borrow on a Priors agent's credit line: check that the agent can borrow this amount for this many days now, and return two links where the agent's owner confirms it: Go mode (go.priors.trade, their account) or Builder mode (priors.trade/agent, the wallet that owns the agent). Nothing is borrowed by this tool: no key, no transaction. Use it when the user wants to borrow USDG for an agent they own.

days.description: Loan term in days: 7, 14 or 30 (the terms Go mode offers).

name: request_borrow
title: Ask to borrow on an agent's Priors line
